findings.title: Reports say 'Certain recalled panel brands' for every 1950-1989 home
evidence: guide #321: CPSC closed its FPE Stab-Lok investigation in 1983 without deciding on a safety risk
local report for a 1985 house showed the line
findings.fix: Change insuranceRedFlag to: 'Certain panel brands from this era with documented breaker problems -- some insurance carriers decline to write policies on homes that still have them.' Same wording fix in guide #50 (DB body).
findings.risk: Engine change: none. Guide #50 is a live ranking page -> needs owner OK, one sentence only.

findings.title: Declared single-family homes labelled 'Condo / Multi-Family Complex' when the street name contains tower/commons/enclave/' ste'/#/' unit'
evidence: local API: 1530 Tower Ave, Superior WI declared single_family -> 'Condo / Multi-Family Complex'
findings.fix: In resolvePropertyMetadata, drop the addrLower.* checks (keep the propTypeLower ones) and let the declared type decide the label; or pass declaredPropertyType in and map it with PROPERTY_TYPE_LABEL. Same lesson as the 2026-11-19 'Lost Trail' fix.
findings.risk: None for SEO. Check that unit-number reports still show Condo via the declared type.

findings.title: Permit Pulse is two months stale on 20 county guides and the study page
findings.fix: Run scripts/build-permit-pulse.ts, then the inject script dry run, then APPLY=true, rebuild, deploy (the designed monthly refresh).
findings.risk: DB writes to 20 live county guides (ranking pages): the refresh only replaces the dated paragraph; needs owner OK.

findings.title: Hurricane Isaias guides still open with the 9 Oct pre-landfall forecast
evidence: live HTML: 'was expected to reach ... that evening'
findings.fix: Rewrite the opening paragraph of #327 and #328 in past tense from the NHC report (verify landfall facts at nhc.noaa.gov first).
findings.risk: Two live pages; owner OK per page; needs verified facts.

findings.title: Research tool promises to 'put the date on your report' but the date is missing
evidence: researchState.ts:307-316 forDeadline does not rewrite 'before your inspection deadline'
HouseResearchTool.tsx:600 date only in 'To confirm before' block
local run: deadline Nov 29 set, report shows no date
findings.fix: In forDeadline also replace 'before your inspection deadline' with 'before <date>' when a deadline is ahead, and show 'Deadline <date>' in the report header whenever state.deadline is set.

findings.title: Soft 404: /about/x/, /advertise/x/, /terms/x/, /accessibility/x/ answer 200 with the homepage
evidence: server.ts:72-83 + 1525-1550 allow one segment under every prefix
findings.fix: Split KNOWN_STATIC_ROUTE_PREFIXES into exact pages (/about, /terms, /privacy, /refunds, /refund-policy, /disclaimer, /accessibility, /support, /advertise, /payment-*) and prefixes that really take a child (/guides/, /counties/, /insights/, /report/, /reports/, /topic-ads/success, /report-ads/..., /my-ads/...). Only the second list allows a segment.
findings.risk: Check App.tsx children first (e.g. /advertise/topic-ads, /report-ads/success) so no real page starts to 404.

findings.title: /api/seo/indexnow has no authentication
evidence: local server: unauthenticated POST only refused when the URL list is missing
findings.fix: Require an admin session (hasValidSession) or remove the route (publishing already pings IndexNow from articlesApi.ts:774).

findings.title: Engine cost ranges have no recorded source but appear on reports and guides
evidence: plan doc notes the 42 cost fields are untraced
findings.fix: Add a source field per cost (or a costs ledger) and a gate that fails an untraced cost; until then label ranges 'typical ranges, not quotes' (already partly there).
findings.risk: Research effort; guides that quote engine figures inherit the fix.

findings.title: 81 of 136 guides have no fact ledger; several high-traffic ones cite no source
findings.fix: Backfill ledgers for the top-traffic unledgered guides first, one page at a time.
findings.risk: Ranking pages: verify-only work is safe; any body edit needs owner OK per page.

findings.title: npm audit: 1 critical (not reachable), 11 high, 3 moderate in production deps
evidence: proxy-addr critical not reachable: no 'trust proxy'
findings.fix: npm audit fix on a branch, run build + gates + smoke test, then deploy.
findings.risk: Dependency bumps (express/body-parser/vite) can break the build; test first.

findings.title: Two research pages contain a second full HTML document inside <head>
evidence: scripts/prerender-research.tsx:825 copies the source file's doctype/html/head/body into the outer head
findings.fix: Before inserting zHead (and the dam equivalent), strip <!DOCTYPE>, <html...>, <head>, </head>, <body...> so only meta/link/style survive.

findings.title: Property-type pop-up is not an accessible dialog; decoder paste box has no label
findings.fix: Add role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-labelledby, Escape to close, focus to first control and back on close; add an aria-label to the textarea.

findings.title: Gold eyebrow labels fail contrast (2.8:1); 'QUICK ANSWER' label 4.36:1
findings.fix: Darken the eyebrow token to reach at least 4.5:1 on cream (one design-token change).

findings.title: Terms 3.6 still offers 'a refund' for a report mismatch though reports are free
findings.fix: Replace 'or a refund determined under our Cancellation & Refund Policy' with nothing (correction or regeneration only) and bump the effective date.

findings.title: 8 guides use banned AI-cliche phrasing
findings.fix: One-phrase edits per page, e.g. #216 'Here is a comprehensive guide on how to research' -> 'How to research'.
findings.risk: Live ranking pages: owner OK per page, never as a batch programme.

findings.title: /api/internal/log-ai-crawler accepts unauthenticated writes
findings.fix: Require a shared secret header set by the edge middleware.

findings.title: Experiment read dates have passed with no recorded result
evidence: 13 memory files show no recorded read result (pattern search); #300 title read on 11-17 is recorded in the index
findings.fix: Run the due reads in date order and write each result into its memory file.

findings.title: Per-IP report cap trusts the leftmost X-Forwarded-For
findings.fix: Use x-real-ip / the platform's client IP header, or the rightmost XFF hop.

findings.title: #13 and #22 'Discovered - currently not indexed', 0 Google impressions in 90 days
findings.fix: None now: #22 restored 2026-11-14 (under 5 weeks); #13 read is due 2026-11-23.
